2609.26124.title: MAC-RRG: Iterative Multi-Agent Collaboration for X-ray Radiology Report Generation
2609.26124.paper_summary: Despite the remarkable progress of LLM-based and knowledge graph-augmented Radiology Report Generation (RRG) methods, existing techniques still suffer from inherent defects. Conventional LLM-only models lack structured medical prior knowledge, resulting in frequent medical hallucinations and low diagnostic interpretability. Current knowledge graph-enhanced schemes adopt static one-round knowledge fusion with single-source knowledge, incapable of dynamic knowledge updating according to generation feedback. This paper proposes a novel Multi-Agent Collaborative iterative framework for X-ray Radiology Report Generation, termed MAC-RRG. Inspired by multi-agent technology, our framework constructs a closed-loop optimization paradigm based on task decoupling and collaborative reasoning. Specifically, the framework first generates a preliminary radiology report from input X-ray images via a vision encoder and a basic LLM. Subsequently, a multimodal knowledge graph (MM-KG) agent mines structured disease correlation and anatomical knowledge from medical knowledge graphs, while an auxiliary knowledge agent extracts unstructured domain knowledge from public medical databases. The multi-source knowledge acquired by dual agents is fused and embedded to guide the LLM in iteratively refining the initial report. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on mainstream X-ray RRG datasets, including IU X-ray, MIMIC, and CheXpert Plus, fully verify the superiority of our proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models have been released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis
2609.26124.paper_summary_zh: 儘管基於大型語言模型（LLM）和知識圖譜增強的放射學報告生成（RRG）方法取得了顯著進展，但現有技術仍然存在固有缺陷。傳統的僅基於LLM的模型缺乏結構化的醫學先驗知識，導致頻繁的醫學幻覺和低診斷可解釋性。目前的知識圖譜增強方案採用靜態的一輪知識融合，且僅依賴單一來源的知識，無法根據生成反饋進行動態知識更新。本文提出了一種新穎的多代理協作迭代框架，用於X光放射學報告生成，稱為MAC-RRG。受到多代理技術的啟發，我們的框架構建了一個基於任務解耦和協作推理的閉環優化範式。具體而言，該框架首先通過視覺編碼器和基本的LLM從輸入的X光圖像生成初步的放射學報告。隨後，多模態知識圖譜（MM-KG）代理從醫學知識圖譜中挖掘結構化的疾病相關性和解剖知識，而輔助知識代理則從公共醫學數據庫中提取非結構化的領域知識。由雙代理獲得的多來源知識被融合並嵌入，以指導LLM迭代地完善初始報告。在主流的X光 RRG數據集上進行的廣泛定量和定性實驗，包括IU X-ray、MIMIC和CheXpert Plus，充分驗證了我們提出方法的優越性。源代碼和預訓練模型已在 https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis 上發布。
